contexts.text: Conjunction with the Lord is effected by means of temptations, and by means of the implantation of faith in love... This alone is to follow Him, that is, to be conjoined with the Lord in the same way as the Lord as to the Human essence was conjoined with Jehovah. TCR 302.
To go after, or to follow = from guidance or protecting oversight.
To be in innocence is signified by to follow the Lamb.
Every affection follows him thither. AC 7085.
The essence and quality of the beginning is derived and passes into the things which follow.
The life which a man has acquired in the world follows him. AC 4227. AC 6977. [AC 7122.]. AC 7295:2, Explained. AC 10813. HH 364.
That the things which precede will reign in those which follow... is evident from... the Lord's Prayer...

That John followed the Lord signified that those who are in the good of charity follow the Lord, and are loved by the Lord, and do not go back; whereas they who are in faith separated not only do not follow the Lord... AE 95.
Therefore the Lord said that he was to follow Him (), by which is meant that he was to acknowledge the Lord as God.
Like a universal entering into all the things which follow.

These are they who follow the Lamb whithersoever He goeth () = that they are conjoined with the Lord through love and faith in Him, because they have lived according to his commandments. Illustrated. AE 864.

Their works do follow with them () = as they have loved and believed and thence have done and spoken. By the works which follow with them are signified all the things which remain with a man after death.

The armies in Heaven followed Him upon white horses... () = the Angels in the New Christian Heaven who are conjoined with the Lord in the interior understanding of the Word... To follow the Lord = to be conjoined with Him.
See Baptism.
Hell followed with him () = eternal damnation... For to follow with him = to remain therein...

No one can follow the Lord from himself, but only from the Lord; for the Lord draws the man after Him who from freedom is willing to follow; but He cannot draw anyone who is not willing to follow Him; for the Lord so operates with him that the man follows Him as it were from himself... For unless it appeared to the man that he follows the Lord as of himself... there would be no appropriation and conjunction...
That to acknowledge the Divine Human of the Lord, and to do His commandments is to follow Him, is because no others can be conjoined with the Lord. AE 864:3, Illustrated. AE 893:3. AE 893:4.
From these things it may be evident that to follow the Lord is to be led by Him, and not by self...
To follow with them = to be in them; for that which follows with anyone, when it is said of his life, is in him, and is as he is; and therefore it is said to follow with them, and not to follow them.
To follow the Lord = to acknowledge Him alone, and to be led by Him.
